event_name: 2026 Nepal Bhote Koshi / Rasuwa Cascading Disaster
hazard_chain: 1. Catastrophic ~600m high-altitude rock and hanging glacier detachment in Lhende Khola catchment (Tibet)
2. Narrow valley impoundment forming temporary high-head barrier lake
3. Sudden overtopping and hyper-velocity transboundary debris surge crossing into Nepal at Rasuwagadhi (~08:40 AM)
4. Destruction of Miteri (Friendship) Bridge, border dry port, and police posts at Timure
5. Downstream stage surge of 8-12m sweeping through Syabrubesi, Betrawati, and Trishuli corridor
cause_primary: Transboundary High-Altitude Rock-Ice Avalanche Damming & Outburst Surge
cause_contributing: Cryospheric thermal degradation on high-altitude Tibetan peaks
Non-precipitation trigger (clear/baseline monsoon conditions, not cloudburst)
Absence of real-time automated cross-border hydrological telemetry
data_availability_before_event: DHM Rasuwagadhi border sensor recorded rapid water surge at 08:40 AM then went offline at 08:50 AM due to structural impact.

key_facts.fact: Over 547 fatalities reported and hundreds missing as of August 28, 2026 (Active Search & Rescue Operation)
key_facts.source: Nepal Army / Armed Police Force / NDRRMA Nepal Situation Bulletin #04

key_facts.fact: Miteri (Friendship) Bridge and Rasuwagadhi border post infrastructure completely destroyed
key_facts.source: Ministry of Home Affairs (MoHA Nepal) / Kathmandu Post

key_facts.fact: Downstream alerts extended into Nuwakot, Dhading, Gorkha, and Chitwan districts
key_facts.source: DHM Nepal National Flood Early Warning Bulletin

evidence_claims.claim: Casualty count actively evolving; preliminary count exceeds 547 missing across border transit, pilgrims, and local settlements.
Border telemetry station destroyed within 10 minutes of surge arrival; rapid rate-of-rise reached 8.4 m/hr prior to sensor failure.

lessons: Sudden sensor communication loss during high rate-of-rise must trigger an automated CRITICAL alert rather than be treated as missing data
Transboundary Himalayan valleys require satellite SAR tripwire alerts and automated downstream siren interlocks
Gorge hydrodynamic propagation lead times (15-25 m/s) must govern downstream settlement evacuation windows

fingerprint.geology_type: Tibetan Tethyan Sedimentary & Higher Himalayan Granite Gneiss
